prompt:
World-class agency editorial photography, the visual standard of a top global creative agency's own website and annual book: sophisticated, modern, restrained, art-directed like a high-end magazine feature (Monocle, Kinfolk, Wallpaper*). Shot on a medium-format camera, 80mm lens at f/2, impeccable craft. Every element of the set is deliberately chosen and color-coordinated; wardrobe is tailored, textured and quietly expensive (fine knit, wool, linen, cotton), in the palette below; NO corporate uniforms, NO logos, NO navy polos. Real skin texture, no retouching look. Two people work together across a table mid-conversation (a woman strategist explaining with an open gesture over a few printed sheets and a closed laptop, a man listening attentively); nobody looks at the camera; no stock smiles, no handshakes. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks anywhere.

POINT OF VIEW (essential): the photograph is taken from the CLIENT'S OWN SEAT at the table, lens only a few centimeters behind the near edge of the table and just above its surface, focus on the strategist's eyes. FOREGROUND (planned): the near edge of the client's side of the table is so close to the lens that it renders as a strongly out-of-focus soft band across the ENTIRE width of the bottom 13% of the frame, with a soft blurred edge; behind it the tabletop gradually comes into focus toward the people; nothing on that near edge. The people sit in the middle band; the upper quarter is calm, out-of-focus architecture and light. Vertical 4:5.

PALETTE AND LIGHT — "Gallery light": a minimalist space of travertine stone, limewashed plaster walls and pale oak; a warm, low-saturation tonal palette of ivory, sand, bone, warm grey and soft terracotta, with deep soft shadows. One large window casts a sculpted, directional beam of late-morning sunlight across the wall and the people, creating elegant light-and-shadow shapes (a clear light pool and graceful falloff). The near edge of the table is very pale ivory travertine stone lit directly by the sunbeam, so bright it is almost white, rendered as a VERY LIGHT, luminous, near-white soft band (much brighter than the wall behind); no shadow falls on it. Wardrobe: ivory, oatmeal and camel tones. Calm, luminous, architectural, timeless.
